wholePhysicalScope: The named temple perimeter, central building and four internal structures follow the native OSM rings. The late nineteenth-century Gazetteer and Visakhapatnam district identify the shrine, connecting portico, sixteen-pillar hall and enclosed verandah. The western gopuram is aligned with the mapped central shrine.
lodDetails: Four authored levels show the west Raja Gopuram, Kalinga sanctum, portico, mandapa and walled courtyard. Near views add multi-stage blue masonry, projecting stucco courses, finials and granite carvings.
limitations: The enclosure, central building footprint and four courtyard ranges are mapped. The tower, colonnade and entrance proportions are estimated from the two published photographs and architectural descriptions.
The west gopuram is centered on the temple axis. The photo GPS establishes the general approach and approximate viewing distance. Local survey dimensions are unavailable.
Individual stone carvings, religious figures and inscriptions are simplified. Interiors and detached approach facilities remain outside the model scope.
